narrative.intro: United Concordia obligated $371M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. United Concordia won 8 awards, the average award size was $46.4M, and obligations fell 7.9% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year show FY21 $438M, FY22 $507M, FY23 $384M, FY24 $387M, FY25 $403M, and FY26 $371M. The Department of Defense is the largest buyer listed. The note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Current-year totals are partial and reflect fiscal year to date activity. The data show multi-year activity concentrated in the $384M to $507M range of annual obligations and a decline into the current fiscal year to date. Use the award count and average award size to size United Concordia's federal contracting footprint and to compare United Concordia to other vendors in similar health and benefits categories.

sections.heading: How concentrated is United Concordia's FY2026 federal business?

sections.heading: How has United Concordia's federal spending trended recently?
sections.body: Obligations rose to $507M in FY22 and then moved lower in subsequent years: FY23 $384M, FY24 $387M, FY25 $403M, and FY26 $371M. Obligations fell 7.9% year over year into FY2026 to date.
